leftEvidence.title: Elijah will be sent before the day of the LORD

points.label: Turning
points.left: He will turn fathers’ hearts to children and children’s hearts to fathers.
points.right: John will turn fathers’ hearts to children and the disobedient to just wisdom.

points.label: Timing
points.left: The promise stands before the great and terrible day.
points.right: The announcement stands before John’s birth and preparatory work.

payload.posture: Hold both sources together while preserving each speaker, setting, sequence, and later use.

rightEvidence.title: John will go before the Lord in Elijah’s spirit and power

payload.tension: Luke reuses Malachi’s turning language while naming John’s work through Elijah’s spirit and power.
payload.title: Elijah promised and Elijah’s spirit announced
